def main():
    n = int(input())
    s = input()
    winCount = 0
    maxLength = 0
    startIdx = 0
    endIdx = 0

    # Replace all double underscores with single underscore
    while "__" in s:
        s = s.replace("__", "_")
    n = len(s)

    # Check if the string starts with '(' and process the first segment
    if s[startIdx] == '(':
        while endIdx < n and s[endIdx] != ')':
            endIdx += 1
        if endIdx < n and s[endIdx] == ')':
            temp = s[startIdx + 1:endIdx]
            if "_" not in temp and len(temp) > 0:
                winCount += 1
            else:
                tokens = temp.split("_")
                winCount += len(tokens)
            startIdx = endIdx + 1

    # Process all other segments enclosed in parentheses
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        if s[i] == '(':
            j = i
            while j < n and s[j] != ')':
                j += 1
            if j < n and s[j] == ')':
                temp = s[i + 1:j]
                if "_" not in temp and len(temp) > 0:
                    winCount += 1
                else:
                    tokens = temp.split("_")
                    winCount += len(tokens)
                i = j
        i += 1

    # Remove all parentheses and their contents
    import re
    while '(' in s or ')' in s:
        s = re.sub(r'\([^()]*\)', '_', s)

    # Find the maximum length of segments separated by underscores
    parts = s.split('_')
    for part in parts:
        if len(part) > maxLength:
            maxLength = len(part)

    print(f"{maxLength} {winCount}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
